point, kept frozen because our transcripts show real, successful use:

  session shipped PRs #975/#951). Upstream successor: `to-tickets` (vendored).
- `design-an-interface` - 1 use (2026-07-20: 10-variant word-map atlas

Frozen at our fork state (upstream last shared commit 2026-06-25). MIT, same

earns new investment, rewrite it as our own skill instead.
